svg.aria-label: The detection chain from the T2* volume to the list of microbleeds
svg.text: cmb-valdo-chain: from the T2* volume to the list of microbleeds
green = paired change of the lesion-level F1 on the 57 VALDO cross-validation cases when the step was introduced · orange = the frozen chain's own F1 at that point
1 Input: one T2*-weighted volume
VALDO Task 2: 3 cohorts, 0.45-1 mm in plane,
0.8-4 mm slices; or an in-house T2* / SWI scan
brain mask as delivered; no T1, no T2, no registration
2 Preprocessing
FSL FAST -B bias correction, once per case
inverted: 1 - image / max inside the brain
NO vessel inpainting (it hid 109 of 236 CMB)
no inpainting: +0.136
3 Common grid + FRST channel
resample to 0.5 x 0.5 x 1 mm, crop to the brain
fast radial symmetry transform, radii 1-3 mm
network input = 2 channels: T2*, FRST
grid +0.06 · FRST kept (without: -0.05)
4 Anisotropic 3D U-Net (a03-aniso)
level 0 in-plane only (conv 1x3x3, pool 1x2x2),
3 isotropic levels + bottleneck, 22.5 M parameters
patch 38 x 31 x 47 mm, 60 epochs, seeds 42 + 1
F1 0.585 raw (seed range 0.55-0.65)
probability map per voxel
5 Fixed operating cell
threshold 0.3, 26-connected components
drop components < 2 mm³ and giant blobs
cell fixed on the inner folds, never on the test fold
deliverable without any rule: 0.585
6 CSF rule (SynthSeg)
FreeSurfer SynthSeg tissue map on the grid
a component whose majority lies in CSF
(sulci, ventricles; 7 labels) is removed
+0.06, no true positive lost · F1 0.647
7 Candidates for a second look
low threshold 0.15 / 1 mm³, CSF kept
16 mm cube per candidate: T2*, FRST and
the stage-1 probability (278 on VALDO)
8 Pooled 3D-CNN classifier
3 conv blocks (16-32-64 ch.), global pool, 1 logit
trained on candidates of ALL cohorts, 3 seeds
flips + offsets; threshold from inner folds
SWI +0.045 · VALDO / T2* within seed noise
kept candidates
9 Output per case
binary CMB mask on the grid; component list with centre, volume (ml), score
burden classes 0 / 1-4 / ≥ 5 (ARIA rule > 4): 0.81 of VALDO cases correct
QC pages: reference left, model outlines right, scroll = z
Results of the frozen chain (lesion-level F1, touch rule, 26-connectivity)
VALDO 5-fold CV 0.647 · 15 held-out cases, measured once: 0.468 pooled, 0.731 without the 73-CMB case
in-house T2* 0.671 · in-house SWI 0.672 (own U-Net per cohort + the shared classifier)
external public SWI cohort, no adaptation: 0.613 (U-Net + CSF rule), 0.630 (+ VALDO classifier)
What did NOT help (measured the same way, paired, pre-registered; nothing adopted)
• other losses: blob, focal-Tversky, no deep supervision
• rotation / scale / contrast augmentation (-0.06)
• 90 or 120 epochs; larger or smaller patches (24 mm: -0.22)
• z-normalisation, landmark harmonisation (all n. s.)
• synthetic lesions in training (-0.07 to -0.13)
• cubic interpolation (-0.02), T1 + T2 extra channels (-0.02)
• wider (48 ch.) or narrower (16 ch.) U-Net, MedNeXt, 2.5D
• vessel rules: run length, Frangi, blobness, border distance
• a second stage per cohort instead of one pooled classifier
• fine-tuning the classifier on 10-25 % of the target cohort

Blue = data preparation, orange = the network, green = rules that survived, purple = the second stage. Detail: docs/WORKLOG.md, docs/OVERVIEW-tests-2026-09-29.md, docs/REPLICATION.md, figure docs/figures/unet.svg.
